dataset.sampling: Equal read-base prefixes from four source BAMs, retaining whole primary records; file-order sampling, not uniform random sampling.
dataset.coverage_definition: Sequenced bases / full GRCh38 chr1-22+X+Y lengths including Ns; mapped depth is measured separately.

source_parts.sampling: First complete primary records in source file order. No length or quality filter.

phase_timings.note: Phase split uses the CLI timers; mapping and temporary-run spilling overlap. Wrapper elapsed time adds about 0.27 seconds to the CLI timer.

validation.comparison_method: Decoded SAM record SHA256 multisets per read; headers excluded. Same-platform scaling check, not x86/ARM qualification.

scope: One 10x HG002 ONT file-order prefix sample, one Apple M4 Pro/macOS ARM64 run, eight threads. Timing includes fresh FASTA index construction, mapping, native coordinate sort, BAM compression, and BAI. Download/input/output validation and coverage are outside the timer. No independent accuracy or cross-platform qualification, and no new source optimization. One bounded one-second stack sample was collected during the final merge; the elapsed timer includes this diagnostic sampling.

merge_diagnostics.method: One-second, 10-ms-interval native process stack sample during final BAM merge
merge_diagnostics.observation: Most sampled sort threads were waiting; read and write syscalls were present. A nearby ps snapshot showed 0.1 percent CPU while an iostat device snapshot showed 890 MB/s aggregate disk6 traffic. Device-wide traffic does not attribute all IO to this process.
merge_diagnostics.source: sorted_bam.rs creates one run-reader and one decoder thread per spilled run; 105 runs in this benchmark. Output already uses a 4-MiB BufWriter.
merge_diagnostics.scope: Diagnostic observation, not a controlled storage comparison or confirmed root cause. No code or output settings changed.

worker_stage_duration_note: Summed worker wall durations, not exact CPU samples or serial elapsed shares; this run uses external input, spill and output files.
